name: Pound
description: A physical attack delivered with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Karate Chop
description: The foe is attacked with a sharp chop. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
effectText: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

name: Double Slap
description: The foe is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times.
effectText: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

name: Comet Punch
description: The foe is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times.
effectText: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

name: Mega Punch
description: The foe is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Pay Day
description: Numerous coins are hurled at the foe. Money is earned after battle.
effectText: Scatters money on the ground worth five times the user’s level.

name: Fire Punch
description: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the foe with a burn.
effectText: Has a chance to burn the target.

name: Ice Punch
description: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the foe frozen.
effectText: Has a chance to freeze the target.

name: Thunder Punch
description: The foe is punched with an electrified fist. It may leave the foe paralyzed.
effectText: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

name: Scratch
description: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Vise Grip
description: Huge, impressive pincers grip and squeeze the foe.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Guillotine
description: A vicious tearing attack with pincers. The foe will faint if it hits.
effectText: Causes a one-hit KO.

name: Razor Wind
description: Blades of wind hit the foe on the 2nd turn. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
effectText: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.

name: Swords Dance
description: A frenetic dance of fighting. It sharply raises the ATTACK stat.
effectText: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages.

name: Cut
description: A basic attack. It can be used to cut down thin trees and grass.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Gust
description: Strikes the foe with a gust of wind whipped up by wings.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Pokémon in the air.

name: Wing Attack
description: The foe is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Whirlwind
description: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.
effectText: Immediately ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.

name: Fly
description: A 2-turn move that hits on the 2nd turn. Use it to fly to any known town.
effectText: User flies high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.

name: Bind
description: A long body or tentacles are used to bind the foe for two to five turns.
effectText: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

name: Slam
description: The foe is struck with a long tail, vines, etc.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Vine Whip
description: The foe is struck with slender, whiplike vines.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Stomp
description: The foe is stomped with a big foot. It may make the foe flinch.
effectText: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

name: Double Kick
description: Two legs are used to quickly kick the foe twice in one turn.
effectText: Hits twice in one turn.

name: Mega Kick
description: The foe is attacked by a kick fired with muscle-packed power.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Jump Kick
description: The user jumps up high, then kicks. If it misses, the user hurts itself.
effectText: If the user misses, it takes half the damage it would have inflicted in recoil.

name: Rolling Kick
description: A quick kick from a rolling spin. It may make the foe flinch.
effectText: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

name: Sand Attack
description: A lot of sand is hurled in the foe’s face, reducing its accuracy.
effectText: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

name: Headbutt
description: The user sticks its head out and rams. It may make the foe flinch.
effectText: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

name: Horn Attack
description: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Fury Attack
description: The foe is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times.
effectText: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

name: Horn Drill
description: The horn is rotated like a drill to ram. The foe will faint if it hits.
effectText: Causes a one-hit KO.

name: Tackle
description: A physical attack in which the user charges, full body, into the foe.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Body Slam
description: The user drops its full body on the foe. It may leave the foe paralyzed.
effectText: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

name: Wrap
description: A long body or vines are used to wrap the foe for two to five turns.
effectText: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

name: Take Down

effectText: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

name: Thrash
description: The user rampages about for two to three turns, then becomes confused.
effectText: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.

name: Double-Edge
description: A reckless, life- risking tackle that also hurts the user a little.
effectText: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.

name: Tail Whip
description: The user wags its tail cutely, making the foe lower its DEFENSE stat.
effectText: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

name: Poison Sting

effectText: Has a chance to poison the target.

name: Twineedle

effectText: Hits twice in the same turn.  Has a chance to poison the target.

name: Leer

name: Bite

name: Growl
description: The user growls in a cute way, making the foe lower its ATTACK stat.
effectText: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

name: Roar
description: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.
effectText: Immediately ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.

name: Sing
description: A soothing song in a calming voice lulls the foe into a deep slumber.
effectText: Puts the target to sleep.

name: Supersonic
description: The user generates odd sound waves. It may confuse the foe.
effectText: Confuses the target.

name: Sonic Boom
description: The foe is hit with a shock wave that always inflicts 20- HP damage.
effectText: Inflicts 20 points of damage.

name: Disable
description: For a few turns, it prevents the foe from using the move it last used.
effectText: Disables the target’s last used move for 1-8 turns.

name: Acid
description: The foe is sprayed with a harsh, hide- melting acid that may lower DEFENSE.
effectText: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

name: Ember

name: Flamethrower

effectText: Has a chance to burn the target.

name: Mist

name: Water Gun

effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Hydro Pump

effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Surf

effectText: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dive users.

name: Ice Beam
description: The foe is struck with an icy beam. It may freeze the foe solid.
effectText: Has a chance to freeze the target.

name: Blizzard
description: The foe is blasted with a blizzard. It may freeze the foe solid.
effectText: Has a chance to freeze the target.

name: Psybeam
description: A peculiar ray is shot at the foe. It may leave the foe confused.
effectText: Has a chance to confuse the target.

name: Bubble Beam

effectText: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

name: Aurora Beam
description: A rainbow-colored attack beam. It may lower the foe’s ATTACK stat.
effectText: Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.

name: Hyper Beam

effectText: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.

name: Peck
description: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Drill Peck
description: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Submission
description: A reckless, full- body throw attack that also hurts the user a little.
effectText: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

name: Low Kick
description: A low, tripping kick that inflicts more damage on heavier foes.
effectText: Inflicts more damage to heavier targets, with a maximum of 120 power.

name: Counter

effectText: Inflicts twice the damage the user received from the last physical hit it took.

name: Seismic Toss
description: A gravity-fed throw that causes damage matching the user’s level.
effectText: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

name: Strength
description: The foe is slugged at maximum power. Can also be used to move boulders.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Absorb
description: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

name: Mega Drain
description: A tough attack that drains half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
effectText: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

name: Leech Seed

effectText: Seeds the target, stealing HP from it every turn.

name: Growth
description: The user’s body is forced to grow, raising the SP. ATK stat.
effectText: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage.

name: Razor Leaf
description: The foe is hit with a cutting leaf. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
effectText: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

name: Solar Beam
description: A 2-turn move that blasts the foe with absorbed energy in the 2nd turn.
effectText: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.

name: Poison Powder
description: A cloud of toxic dust is scattered. It may poison the foe.
effectText: Poisons the target.

name: Stun Spore
description: Paralyzing dust is scattered wildly. It may paralyze the foe.
effectText: Paralyzes the target.

name: Sleep Powder

effectText: Puts the target to sleep.

name: Petal Dance
description: The user attacks with petals for two to three turns, then gets confused.
effectText: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.

name: String Shot

effectText: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

name: Dragon Rage
description: The foe is hit with a shock wave that always inflicts 40- HP damage.
effectText: Inflicts 40 points of damage.

name: Fire Spin
description: The foe is trapped in an intense spiral of fire that rages two to five turns.
effectText: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

name: Thunder Shock
description: An electric shock attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.
effectText: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

name: Thunderbolt
description: A strong electrical attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.
effectText: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

name: Thunder Wave
description: A weak electric shock that is sure to cause paralysis if it hits.
effectText: Paralyzes the target.

name: Thunder
description: A brutal lightning attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.
effectText: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

name: Rock Throw
description: The foe is attacked with a shower of small, easily thrown rocks.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Earthquake

effectText: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dig users.

name: Fissure
description: The foe is dropped into a fissure. The foe faints if it hits.
effectText: Causes a one-hit KO.

name: Dig

effectText: User digs underground, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.

name: Toxic
description: A move that badly poisons the foe. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
effectText: Badly poisons the target, inflicting more damage every turn.

name: Confusion
description: A weak telekinetic attack that may also leave the foe confused.
effectText: Has a chance to confuse the target.

name: Psychic
description: A strong telekinetic attack. It may also lower the foe’s SP. DEF stat.
effectText: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

name: Hypnosis
description: Hypnotic suggestion is used to make the foe fall into a deep sleep.
effectText: Puts the target to sleep.

name: Meditate
description: The user meditates to awaken its power and raise its ATTACK stat.

name: Agility

name: Quick Attack

effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Rage

name: Teleport

effectText: Immediately ends wild battles.  No effect otherwise.

name: Night Shade
description: An attack with a mirage that inflicts damage matching the user’s level.
effectText: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

name: Mimic
description: The user copies the move last used by the foe for the rest of the battle.
effectText: Copies the target’s last used move.

name: Screech
description: An ear-splitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s DEFENSE.
effectText: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.

name: Double Team
description: The user creates illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
effectText: Raises the user’s evasion by one stage.

name: Recover
description: A self-healing move that restores HP by up to half of the user’s maximum HP.
effectText: Heals the user by half its max HP.

name: Harden
description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its DEFENSE stat.
effectText: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.

name: Minimize

effectText: Raises the user’s evasion by two stages.

name: Smokescreen

effectText: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

name: Confuse Ray

effectText: Confuses the target.

name: Withdraw

name: Defense Curl

effectText: Raises user’s Defense by one stage.

name: Barrier

effectText: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

name: Light Screen

name: Haze
description: Eliminates all stat changes among all POKéMON engaged in battle.

name: Reflect
description: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.

name: Focus Energy

name: Bide

name: Metronome

effectText: Randomly selects and uses any move in the game.

name: Mirror Move

effectText: Uses the target’s last used move.

name: Self-Destruct
description: The user blows up to inflict severe damage, even making itself faint.
effectText: User faints.

name: Egg Bomb
description: A large egg is hurled with great force at the foe to inflict damage.
effectText: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Lick
description: The foe is licked and hit with a long tongue. It may also paralyze.
effectText: Has a chance to paralyze the target.

name: Smog
description: The foe is attacked with exhaust gases. It may also poison the foe.
effectText: Has a chance to poison the target.

name: Sludge

effectText: Has a chance to poison the target.

name: Bone Club

effectText: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

name: Fire Blast
description: The foe is hit with an intense flame. It may leave the target with a burn.
effectText: Has a chance to burn the target.

name: Waterfall

effectText: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

name: Clamp

effectText: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

name: Swift

effectText: Never misses.

name: Skull Bash

name: Spike Cannon

effectText: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

name: Constrict

effectText: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

name: Amnesia

name: Glare

effectText: Paralyzes the target.

name: Dream Eater

name: Poison Gas
description: The foe is sprayed with a cloud of toxic gas that may poison the foe.
effectText: Poisons the target.

name: Barrage
description: Round objects are hurled at the foe to strike two to five times.
effectText: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

name: Leech Life
description: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
effectText: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

name: Lovely Kiss

effectText: Puts the target to sleep.

name: Sky Attack

name: Bubble
description: A spray of bubbles hits the foe. It may lower the foe’s SPEED stat.
effectText: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

name: Dizzy Punch
description: The foe is hit with a rhythmic punch that may leave it confused.
effectText: Has a chance to confuse the target.

name: Spore
description: The user scatters bursts of fine spores that induce sleep.
effectText: Puts the target to sleep.

name: Flash

effectText: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

name: Psywave

effectText: Inflicts damage between 50% and 150% of the user’s level.

name: Splash
description: The user just flops and splashes around without having any effect.

name: Acid Armor
description: The user alters its cells to liquefy itself and sharply raise DEFENSE.
effectText: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

name: Crabhammer
description: A large pincer is used to hammer the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
effectText: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

name: Explosion

name: Slash

effectText: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

name: Substitute

name: Struggle

name: Sketch

name: Spider Web

name: Mind Reader

name: Sweet Kiss

name: Sludge Bomb

effectText: Has a chance to poison the target.

name: Mud-Slap

name: Octazooka

effectText: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
